# Accessibility

## Scope and Goals

We aim to make this repository's documentation and contribution workflows accessible. When updating documentation, use logical headings, descriptive links, useful image descriptions, and text alternatives for essential video content. Report accessibility barriers through the existing issue template so maintainers can consider improvements.

## Known Limitations

The repository has not undergone a formal accessibility audit or systematic assistive-technology testing. Older tutorials and third-party content may have accessibility barriers. GitHub's interface and linked clients or services are maintained by their respective providers.

## Reporting a Barrier

[Open an issue](https://github.com/VPN-Subcription-Links/ClashX-V2Ray-TopFreeProxy/issues/new?template=report.md) with the affected page, the barrier, and the expected experience. Include reproduction steps and browser or assistive-technology details if useful. You do not need to disclose a diagnosis or personal information. See the [contribution guidelines](CONTRIBUTING.md) for general guidance.

# 无障碍说明

## 范围与目标

我们希望仓库文档和贡献流程便于不同需求的用户使用。更新文档时，请使用层次清晰的标题、含义明确的链接、有用的图片描述，并为重要的视频内容提供文字替代。可通过现有的问题模板反馈无障碍障碍，供维护者考虑改进。

## 已知限制

本仓库尚未进行正式的无障碍审查或系统性的辅助技术测试。较早的教程及第三方内容可能存在无障碍障碍。GitHub 界面及链接的客户端或服务由各自的提供方维护。

## 反馈障碍

请[提交 Issue](https://github.com/VPN-Subcription-Links/ClashX-V2Ray-TopFreeProxy/issues/new?template=report.md)，说明受影响的页面、遇到的障碍及预期体验。如有帮助，可附上复现步骤、浏览器或辅助技术信息。无需提供诊断结果或个人信息。一般贡献说明见[贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.md)。
